claim_boundary: This component gate is registered after the direct observation-clamped target sentinel outcomes became known (fern 0.4904543886, horns_left 0.8207416104). Those target outcomes motivate stopping unconditional graph completion but do not set any fold, score, margin, component, or scene-specific gate value below. All gate decisions use source-view exact-W observations only.
first_principles_hypothesis: An unknown component is safe to complete only if its observed source boundary ring can be predicted from the remaining source boundaries more accurately than the graph-off field prior under a proper held-out score. Otherwise graph-off is the only authorized output.

required_for_each_sentinel: observed rows remain bitwise equal to graph-off unary
rejected and no-boundary component rows remain bitwise equal to graph-off unary
at least one component with positive validation evidence is accepted
at least one component with positive validation evidence is rejected
accepted-component aggregate candidate Brier is strictly below accepted-component aggregate field Brier
source_only_diagnostic_gate.failure_action: Stop graph completion and retain the frozen graph-off hierarchical-trust v2 result.
source_only_diagnostic_gate.pass_action: Seal the gated selector before any new target rendering; any target result remains posthoc development evidence.
